channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.0).

item.title: [+1] India and US race to seal trade deal before Trump’s G20 summit
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 27 reports from The Economic Times, Deccan Herald, The Hindu and 21 more. Related: “US assures India of tariff edge over competitors in trade pact”. Ongoing: also reported on 3 of the previous 7 days (first 8 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India clocks record $89.99 billion exports in October, but merchandise trade deficit hits 1-year high
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 10 reports from KNN India, JournalArta, BusinessLine and 7 more. Related: “India exports hit record $90 billion in October; merchandise trade deficit rises to $39.88 billion”. Mixed: 6 reports point the other way. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] ALEMA seeks removal of 8.25% aluminium import duty, calls for 10-year relief
item.description:
Signal: higher metal prices. 3 reports from AL Circle, Shanghai Metals Market, Indian PSU. Related: “[SMM Steel] India's Domestic Steel Prices Rise Amid Cautious Buying”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Input costs rise

Why it matters: Rising metal prices lift Indian steel, aluminium and zinc producers while raising input costs for automakers, builders and capital-goods makers.

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
